body:
## Owner-approved correction
Guy explicitly requests illustrations ALWAYS in rows, including when real photos exist. Actual food photos belong inside detail/edit only. This supersedes #199 photo-first row and blank unknown/mixed-meal policies; retain original photo storage and detail access.

## Grounded gap
Released 389b4f5 app/Sources/Morsel/FoodArtwork.swift resolves the entire meal to none if any name is unmatched or categories differ. TodayLogViews.swift places MealArtworkSlot only in MealGroupView header; MealItemRow is text-only. FoodArtworkView.swift gives photoPath priority. Reuse catalog and illustration renderer; separate row presentation from detail-photo presentation.

## Acceptance
- Every actual food item row in Today and day detail has visible bundled theme-matched artwork. Exact food/alias, then supported category mapping, then approved neutral hand-drawn food fallback; no blank on unknown names.
- History meal-summary rows likewise always show an appropriate generic/category illustration, never a real photo; mixed meals use neutral artwork rather than an arbitrary ingredient.
- One unmatched item cannot suppress others. No-photo and photo-present fixtures both show illustrations in rows.
- Real photos remain stored unchanged and accessible inside meal/item detail/edit with existing attach/replace behavior. Do not duplicate a meal-level photo as item-specific evidence.
- No per-log generation/network dependency, no nutrition/category inference written back to logged data, no photo deletion or fabricated attachment. Reuse approved visual style; designer lane supplies neutral fallback if absent.
- Reproduce owner food names: Focaccia bread, Mortadella, Stracciatella cheese, Grilled vegetable topping. Prove visible output in actual app Today/History/detail, Paper and Night, including unknown/mixed/photo-present cases.
- Regression tests must discriminate old blank/photo-first behavior; review PASS and CI green before staging merge. New main promotion/TestFlight remains owner-gated.

## Separate photo question
Screenshot does NOT establish whether agent uploaded original photo. Existing logging skill requires actual bytes when exposed, image_error disclosure, and get_day attachment readback. Do not claim this specific meal has or lacks a stored photo without authenticated account-scoped readback. No unrelated database writes authorized.

Refs #199 #197 #198; coordinate shared image surfaces with #188 and #179.

**ROUTED for execution** — owner-approved correction, queued through the normal safe impl→review→staging gate (mandate #198).

## Disposition

- **Priority:** next **disjoint image/UI native slot**. `impl-179-native-image-signing` holds the current native gate (file-disjoint: `Repository.swift` / `SupabaseMealReadModel.swift` / `MealThumbnail.swift`). #223 takes the slot immediately after it, and is **serialized against #188** (both touch image surfaces — no two native lanes at once).
- **Dependency:** the **approved neutral hand-drawn food fallback study** does not exist (grep-confirmed: `FoodArtwork.swift:19-23` "the approved library carries no unknown/other study"; `app/Resources/FoodArt/catalog.json` = 17 assets, 13 `food` + 4 **category** `fallback`, none neutral). A **designer lane** has been spawned to supply it (art pipeline + catalog + `food-art` skill only). #223's impl builds on that asset.
- **Base:** `origin/staging` at dispatch time (currently `ac1460d`); re-verify at the slot.

## Scope (supersedes #199's photo-first row policy)

- `app/Sources/Morsel/FoodArtwork.swift` — resolution must not return "no illustration": exact food/alias → supported category mapping → **approved neutral fallback**; a meal must never resolve to `none`, and **one unmatched item must not suppress the others**.
- `app/Sources/Morsel/FoodArtworkView.swift` — separate **row** presentation (illustration always) from **detail** presentation (real photo).
- `app/Sources/Morsel/TodayLogViews.swift` — `MealItemRow` (~line 169) currently text-only and `MealArtworkSlot` sits only in the meal header (~line 80): every actual food item row needs visible artwork.
- History meal-summary rows — generic/category illustration, **never a real photo**; mixed meals use neutral artwork, not an arbitrary ingredient.
- `app/Resources/FoodArt/**` bundling + focused tests + `docs/evidence/`.

## Proof bar (owner-set, non-negotiable)

Visible output in the **actual app** on Today, History and detail, in **Paper and Night**, covering **unknown / mixed / photo-present** cases, reproducing the owner's real names — **Focaccia bread, Mortadella, Stracciatella cheese, Grilled vegetable topping** (none currently in the catalog). Regression tests must **discriminate the old blank/photo-first behaviour** (RED on it, GREEN after).

## Boundaries

Real photos stay stored unchanged and accessible in detail/edit with existing attach/replace behaviour (**do not duplicate a meal-level photo as item-level evidence**). No per-log generation or network dependency; no nutrition/category inference written back to logged data; no photo deletion; no fabricated attachment. The issue's "separate photo question" stands: do not claim this or any meal has/lacks a stored photo without authenticated account-scoped readback, and no unrelated database writes are authorized.

**Release boundary:** review PASS + CI green → **staging only**. **No new main promotion, release, deploy or TestFlight is authorized** — those remain owner-gated.

This routing is a conductor decision, not a re-approval.

title: [iOS food art] Always illustrate food rows; keep real meal photos inside detail
